title: My Dream House
description: Practise prepositions of place, comparatives and superlatives, then describe your dream house.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: There is a big swimming pool ___ the garden.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" for something inside an area: in the garden.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My bedroom is ___ (large) room in the house.
answers: the largest
exercises.explanation: Use "the" + superlative to compare one thing with all the others. Adjectives ending in -e just add -st: large - the largest.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The kitchen is next to the living room.
The living room is next to the kitchen.
Is the kitchen next to the living room?
Is the living room next to the kitchen?
exercises.explanation: "Next to" means beside: The kitchen is next to the living room.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are a cinema room in the basement.
answers: There is a cinema room in the basement.
There's a cinema room in the basement.
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" with a singular noun (a cinema room) and "there are" with plural nouns.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: My dream house is ___ than my flat now.
exercises.explanation: Long adjectives use "more" to make the comparative: modern - more modern.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one preposition.
exercises.text: It is ___ a hill, near the sea.
answers: on
exercises.explanation: Use "on" for a position on top of a surface: on a hill.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I think my dream house ___ very expensive.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb for predictions: it will be expensive.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "going to" and the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: One day I ___ (build) a house by the sea.
answers: am going to build
'm going to build
exercises.explanation: For plans and intentions we use am/is/are + going to + verb: I am going to build.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: There are some trees in the garden.
In the garden there are some trees.
exercises.explanation: There are + some + plural noun + place: There are some trees in the garden.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: It will be the most big house in my street.
answers: It will be the biggest house in my street.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives make the superlative with -est, not "most": big - the biggest.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: There won't be ___ furniture in my bedroom, just a bed and a desk.
exercises.explanation: "Furniture" is uncountable, so we use "much" in negative sentences.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one preposition.
exercises.text: My bedroom is ___ the kitchen, on the first floor.
answers: above
over
exercises.explanation: "Above" means in a higher position: the bedroom is above the kitchen. The opposite is "below".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My dream house will be near the sea.
Will my dream house be near the sea?
exercises.explanation: Subject + will + be + place: My dream house will be near the sea.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My house will have a lot of furnitures.
answers: My house will have a lot of furniture.
exercises.explanation: "Furniture" is uncountable, so it never has a plural -s.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: Are there ___ shops near your dream house?
exercises.explanation: We usually use "any" in questions with plural nouns: Are there any shops?

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: The view from the top floor is ___ (good) than the view from the ground floor.
answers: better
exercises.explanation: "Good" has an irregular comparative: good - better - the best.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I grew up in a small flat.
exercises.explanation: "Grow up" is irregular: grow up - grew up.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There will be a swimming pool at the roof.
answers: There will be a swimming pool on the roof.
exercises.explanation: We use "on" for the top surface of something: on the roof, on the table.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I want a big garden ___ I love growing flowers.
exercises.explanation: "Because" introduces a reason: I want a garden because I love flowers.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My house won't to be in the city.
answers: My house won't be in the city.
exercises.explanation: After "won't" (will not) we use the base verb without "to": won't be.

contentPoints: Explain why it is your dream house.
task.modelAnswer: My dream house is on a hill near the sea. It is bigger and more modern than my flat now. It has four bedrooms, a big kitchen and a cinema room. My bedroom is the largest room in the house. It has a huge window, so I can see the sea from my bed. There is also a swimming pool in the garden. I love this house because it is quiet and bright.
